messages.content: The flights are done, so compare the two resorts for the full six nights now. I want taxes, resort charges, breakfast, airport transportation, realistic meals, and one spa visit for both of us included. Also confirm the exact room and cancellation deadline before we choose.

I refreshed both quotes for November 28 through December 4. The beachfront resort is offering an Ocean View King at $4,628.40 including taxes and the six nightly resort charges. Daily breakfast for two and private round-trip airport transportation are included. The adults-only resort has a Garden Suite King at $4,210.80 including taxes and resort charges, but breakfast, other meals, and transfers are separate. I am checking the cancellation terms and pricing one comparable spa visit at each property.
What are you using for meals at the beachfront place if breakfast is covered?

I would allow $900 for two people across the stay: six lunches averaging $55 per day, six dinners averaging $90 per day, and $30 for snacks, coffee, or a light arrival meal. That includes estimated tax and service charges but not alcoholic drinks or discretionary gratuities.
That seems reasonable. Do the adults-only estimate the same way, but include breakfast there.

For the adults-only resort, the comparable food estimate is $1,560 for two. That covers six breakfasts, six lunches, six dinners, and incidental food or coffee, with estimated tax and service charges included. Its private round-trip airport transfer is $96.
And the spa? We only need one treatment each, preferably at the same time.

At the beachfront resort, two simultaneous 80-minute massages are available December 1 at 2:00 p.m. The tax-inclusive charge is $417.60; gratuity is separate. At the adults-only resort, the same-length massages are available together November 30 at 11:00 a.m. or December 2 at 3:30 p.m. The combined charge is $440 including tax, also before gratuity.
Give me the complete totals side by side, including the flights we already paid for, so there is no ambiguity.

Beachfront resort: $4,628.40 room, taxes, and resort charges; $0 for included breakfasts; $0 for included private airport transportation; $900 for remaining meals; $417.60 for two massages; and $1,152 for the purchased flights. Full estimated trip total: $7,098.

Adults-only resort: $4,210.80 room, taxes, and resort charges; $1,560 for all meals including breakfast; $96 for private transfers; $440 for two massages; and $1,152 for flights. Full estimated trip total: $7,458.80.

The beachfront option is $360.80 less on a comparable basis.
Confirm that the beachfront room is actually ocean view, not partial ocean view or resort view with clever wording.

Confirmed: the bookable category is Ocean View King. The rate description guarantees a direct ocean-facing view from the furnished balcony. It is not the Partial Ocean View King or the Resort View King category. Bedding is one king bed, and maximum occupancy is two adults.
What exactly is included in its breakfast and transfer bundle?

Breakfast for two is included each morning at the main restaurant and covers the buffet or one entree per person, juice, and coffee or tea. Room-service breakfast, alcohol, and gratuities are excluded. Transportation is a private round-trip car between PVR and the resort for both travelers. The arrival pickup is tied to the booked inbound flight, and the return car is scheduled from the resort to PVR on December 4.
Now the deposit and cancellation dates for both. Please use calendar dates, not a number of days before arrival.

The beachfront resort requires a $2,314.20 deposit when booked. It is fully refundable through 11:59 p.m. resort local time on November 13, 2026. From November 14 onward, the entire $2,314.20 deposit is nonrefundable; the remaining $2,314.20 is charged at check-in. Its current quote expires tonight.

The adults-only resort requires $2,105.40 now. It is fully refundable through 11:59 p.m. resort local time on October 30, 2026. After that, the deposit is nonrefundable; the balance is due at check-in. Its quote expires tomorrow.
Earlier the beachfront amount due was much smaller. Why did it change so much?

The earlier $510 deposit applied to a room-only flexible rate that did not include daily breakfast or airport transportation. That rate is no longer available for the full six-night stay. The current bundled Ocean View King rate requires 50% of the tax-inclusive room total at booking, which is $2,314.20. The total I gave does not add a separate breakfast or transfer charge.
Understood. Is there any mandatory charge still missing from either total?

No mandatory hotel charge is omitted. Both room figures include lodging tax and the nightly resort charge. The estimates also include the specified food, private transfers, and one massage each. Variable items still outside the totals are alcohol, optional excursions, spa gratuities, discretionary dining gratuities beyond included service charges, and any airline purchases beyond the checked bags already included.
The beachfront one is the better overall choice. Book the Ocean View King bundle and reserve the two massages on December 1 at 2:00. Use the card ending in 1842.

Before I submit: the card ending in 1842 will be charged $2,314.20 now for the beachfront Ocean View King from November 28 through December 4. The room is refundable through November 13, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. resort local time. The two 80-minute massages on December 1 at 2:00 p.m. will be guaranteed to that card, with $417.60 charged by the spa according to its appointment terms. Shall I complete both reservations?
Yes, complete both.

Booked. The card ending in 1842 was charged $2,314.20 for the six-night Ocean View King bundle at the beachfront resort, confirmation PV8R26. Daily restaurant breakfast for two and private round-trip PVR transportation are included. The room remains refundable through November 13, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. resort local time; $2,314.20 remains due at check-in. Two simultaneous 80-minute massages are reserved for December 1 at 2:00 p.m., spa confirmation SP4017, for $417.60 before gratuity. Including the $1,152 flights, $900 estimated remaining meals, and the spa visit, the projected trip total is $7,098.
